analysis: Three changes examined. (1) NemotronSuperServingPolicy.swift line 369: maximumEncodedBodyBytes rises from 8 MiB to 40 MiB. It feeds encodedHeaderQuote (lines 401, 445), encodedCopies (406) and videoChargeBytes (448), so media-charge reservations grow with it. The comment says it matches the 32 MiB transport limits (localInferenceMaxUploadBytes, CoordinatorClient.maxInboundMessageBytes). Memory-reservation arithmetic is unchanged and still overflow-checked in the unit shown. The larger per-request media charge shrinks the serving/bank headroom in defaultPrefixBankBytes, which can reduce availability or prefix-bank sizing. The ledger, the grant check and the builder reservations remain authoritative, but their enforcement code was not supplied. The actual ingress limit in NemotronSuperLocalImageBinding and the decoder bounds (maximumImageDecodeBytes, maximumImages) were not visible, so I cannot confirm a larger body cannot bypass reservation. That is a question for integration (T-010, TB-007 availability). (2) NemotronSuperRequestPlan.swift lines 82-88: the refusal of JSON response_format combined with tools is removed. The remaining validations stay: logprobs, prompt_cache_key, logit_bias, n, min_p, parsers, model id. I see no authorization or encryption impact. (3) NemotronSuperLocalOutput.swift lines 93-97: when tool calls are present, response-format normalization/validation is skipped and the content passes unchanged. ToolConstraintValidation.validate on the calls still runs first, and the forced-choice residual-whitespace check is preserved. This is the intended semantics, and no trust-boundary change follows. The remaining question is whether the unnormalized content text emitted alongside tool calls is bounded or sanitized the same way as before. It is consumer-facing output from the provider's own model, so it is not a confidentiality issue. No threat-model IDs are regressed. The T-041 prefix cache is untouched, and prompt_cache_key is still refused. Residual uncertainty: the enforcement points for the new 40 MiB body size are outside the supplied units.
